# Copilot repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the single-source documentation map in [README.md](../README.md). Respect assigned paths, interface-first integration, evidence-backed tests and the actual event constraints. No claims of passing tests without observed execution.

Current team scope: **RiceWatch P0 autonomous rice-water alert inspection and diagnosis**. The rover must physically collect an independent local water measurement and adapt to a mid-run obstruction. **Gate actuation, pumping, flood mitigation, second robot/rescue and other domains are optional only**; do not add them to initial acceptance criteria. Follow [PRODUCT](../docs/PRODUCT.md) and [first build task](../docs/RUN.md#next-agent-first-integration-task--not-yet-implemented).
